_published_faq.name: How do I add TimeChimp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TimeChimp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.timechimp.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TimeChimp MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TimeChimp provides these MCP tools: get_hours, get_projects, and get_user_info_.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TimeChimp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to TimeChimp in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
TimeChimp requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
TimeChimp is developed by TimeChimp. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
